documentation.file_docstring:
Reward Distribution Strategies.

Pluggable strategies for distributing rewards among task participants
based on trust scores, delegation depth, or explicit contribution weights.
member_docstrings: ParticipantInfo: Information about a single task participant.
RewardPool: A pool of rewards to distribute for a completed task.
RewardAllocation: Allocation result for a single participant.
DistributionResult: Complete result of a reward distribution.
RewardStrategy: Protocol for pluggable reward distribution strategies.
EqualSplitStrategy: Divide rewards equally among all participants.
TrustWeightedStrategy: Distribute rewards weighted by trust score.

HierarchicalStrategy: Distribute rewards based on delegation depth with configurable decay.

classes.name: HierarchicalStrategy
classes.doc:
Distribute rewards based on delegation depth with configurable decay.

Root agents (depth 0) receive the largest share. Each successive
delegation level receives ``decay_factor`` times the weight of the
previous level.

classes.name: ContributionWeightedStrategy
classes.doc:
Distribute rewards by explicit contribution weights.

Participants without a ``contribution_weight`` receive a weight of 0.
